rationale: The agent identified the user and the relevant order, and initiated a return to the original payment method. However, per policy the agent must confirm every order-changing action before executing it. The return was submitted without prior user confirmation, as evidenced by the immediate call to return_delivered_order_items and the statement that the request "has been submitted." This violates the confirmation requirement, so the interaction does not meet the pass bar despite otherwise plausible details.
